model_review.scope: Same ideal geometric model; independent quadrature does not test leakage, inlet filling or finite-length end effects. Finite reduced DE does not certify global optimality.

nm_polish_diagnostics.selection: converged feasible NM endpoints more than 1e-5 relative below the best SLSQP value for that N
nm_polish_diagnostics.timing: separate diagnostic; excluded from main comparison

nm_penalty_rationale: Pilot checks at N=1 and N=4 found 1e5 infeasible and 1e7 feasible under the common 1e-6 threshold. Full study uses fixed 1e7; sweep reported separately.
